## Task

Write the RED test suite for `plugins/dso/scripts/coherence-walk.sh` before the script exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test file created at `tests/scripts/test-coherence-walk.sh`
- [ ] Tests cover: no-args exits 1 with usage message; --help exits 0; explicit ticket-id list mode returns PASS/FAIL/AMBIGUOUS per artifact; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY absent exits 0 with WARNING (graceful degradation); --dry-run flag exits 0 without API call; aggregate summary line emitted; FAIL result includes recommended next step in output; exit code 0 when all PASS, exit code 1 when any FAIL
- [ ] All tests fail (RED) before coherence-walk.sh exists — verified via `bash tests/scripts/test-coherence-walk.sh`
- [ ] testing-mode: RED marker included in test file header comment

## File Impact
- `tests/scripts/test-coherence-walk.sh` — create (RED test)
data.title: RED test: coherence-walk.sh exit codes and output format
